plugins.name: Webcam Preview
plugins.author: fluidnc-webcontrol
plugins.description: Live preview for one or more webcams - USB cameras on the Pi, or IP cameras on your network - shown on the main screen.

plugins.name: Fan SHIM Control
plugins.author: fluidnc-webcontrol
plugins.description: Automatic temperature-based fan control for the Pimoroni Fan SHIM, with configurable on/off thresholds.

plugins.name: Notifications
plugins.author: fluidnc-webcontrol
plugins.description: Push notifications for machine events (alarms, job completion, connection loss) via ntfy.sh, Discord, or Telegram.

plugins.name: Smart Plug Control
plugins.author: fluidnc-webcontrol
plugins.description: Turn the spindle's smart plug on before a job (with a spin-up delay) and off after - regardless of how the job ended.

plugins.name: Z-Probe | Touch Plate
plugins.author: fluidnc-webcontrol
plugins.description: Touch-plate Z probing - probes down, zeros work Z corrected for the plate's thickness, then retracts clear. Bundled as a plugin (rather than a core feature) since Z-probe hardware varies a lot - swap this out for a different plugin if yours works differently.

plugins.name: Surfacing / Facing
plugins.author: fluidnc-webcontrol
plugins.description: Generates a raster facing toolpath for flattening a spoilboard or panel - set your dimensions and cutter, generate, and it loads straight into the Program tab ready to run.
